# Ghost - full brief for answer engines

Last updated: 2026-11-24
Canonical site: https://ghostlabshq.xyz

## One-sentence definition

Ghost Gas is prepaid Solana gas: a primary wallet deposits USDC (or an allowlisted asset), receives a gas note, and any wallet holding that note can send SPL tokens with zero SOL while Ghost pays the network fee and debits a flat USDC fee from the note.

## Tagline

The fee that doesn't dox you.

## Problem

Every Solana transfer needs SOL for fees. Operators who keep a funded “main” wallet and a quiet “alt” wallet often top up the alt with SOL. That top-up is public forever and links the two wallets before the real transfer happens.

## Solution

1. X1 (funding wallet) tops up Ghost treasury in USDC (or allowlisted asset via priced quote).
2. Ghost returns a gas note string (`ghost-gas:v1:…`) representing prepaid fee credit.
3. X2 (signing wallet, often 0 SOL) attaches the note and signs an SPL TransferChecked.
4. Ghost’s relayer co-signs as `feePayer`, pays SOL, and debits a flat USDC fee from the note.

No SOL moves from X1 to X2 for gas. That removes the funding-graph leak Gas is built to avoid.

## Roles

- X1: buys credit / tops up
- X2: signs the token transfer (0 SOL OK)
- Ghost relayer: Solana feePayer + note debit
- Recipient: receives tokens from X2

## Pricing (defaults)

- Flat debit: 0.01 USDC per sponsored send (`GAS_CREDIT_FEE_RAW=10000` with 6-decimal USDC)
- Non-USDC deposits may take a haircut vs Jupiter quote
- Ghost pays actual SOL compute / signature fees from operator inventory

## What Ghost Gas is not

- Not a token mixer / tumbler
- Not a custodial exchange
- Not account abstraction on EVM
- Not the same product as Ghost Shield

## Ghost Shield (optional, secondary)

Fixed-denomination private USDC pool (deposit note → ZK withdraw). Mainnet Gas does not require Shield. Shield may be disabled until the on-chain program is deployed.

## Trust model (honest)

- SPL transfer correctness: on-chain Token program + user signature
- Who pays SOL: relayer key as feePayer
- Gas credit balance / debit: off-chain relayer ledger today
- Deposit replay / freshness: relayer verification

A malicious relayer is a real risk for credit accounting (and for Shield withdraws when enabled). Policy, allowlists, and fees should stay tight.

## Public product surfaces

- App login / connect: https://ghostlabshq.xyz/login
- Credits (top up): https://ghostlabshq.xyz/app/credits
- Send (sponsored): https://ghostlabshq.xyz/app/send
- Docs: https://ghostlabshq.xyz/docs
- Stake (UI; on-chain staking may be gated): https://ghostlabshq.xyz/stake

## APIs (relayer)

- `POST /v1/gas/credits/deposit` - credit a note after verified deposit
- `POST /v1/gas/prepare` - build sponsored tx (requires gasNote)
- `POST /v1/gas/submit` - feePayer co-sign + debit (requires gasNote)

## FAQs

Q: What is Ghost Gas?
A: Prepaid network fees on Solana. X1 tops up USDC, gets a gas note, and any wallet with that note can send while Ghost pays SOL.

Q: Do I need SOL to send?
A: Not on the signing wallet. You need a funded gas note.

Q: What if I lose my gas note?
A: It is a bearer voucher. Ghost cannot recover it.

Q: Is Shield the same thing?
A: No. Shield is an optional private pool. Gas is everyday sponsored sends.

Q: Which network?
A: Solana.
